description: AGSC-09-94: run and trace have no effect unless run.enabled is true, and with it false (the default of AGSC-01-18) both exit 2 with AGSC-E004 — a configuration the tool cannot run against, AGSC-09-08's exit-2 class — and no run block is read. Derivation: the verb is one of the sixteen, so AGSC-E001 (unknown verb) cannot name the fault; the refusal comes from the configuration, which is what AGSC-E004 is registered for. The minimal fixture carries no run block, so run.enabled is false by default.
